capabilities: Render etch-weather code blocks that fetch forecasts from Open-Meteo
Etch a forecast permanently into a code block via a pen icon
Infer the forecast date from daily note titles
Override the default location per code block
Configure default location and measurement units in settings
extras: Not yet in the community plugin list; the README says to install a release via BRAT until it is approved. Uses the free Open-Meteo API (no API key or account mentioned). The README notes code reuse from another plugin but its attribution sentences appear truncated.
intentEvidence: I wanted another plugin like [parente/obsidian-etch-google-calendar], this time to get an glimpse of expected weather
motivation: The author wanted a companion to parente/obsidian-etch-google-calendar that shows expected weather in daily notes and maintains a history of those forecasts in Markdown files.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to capture weather forecasts in notes, so users cannot keep an offline, permanent record of expected weather in their daily notes.

relations.evidence: All weather data by Open-Meteo.com under the Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) license.

summary: Fenced code block plugin that fetches daily weather forecasts from Open-Meteo and etches them permanently into local Markdown notes.
